findings.passage: Two biographies that could shift the picture, Matthew Symonds's _Softwar_ and Mike Wilson's _The Difference Between God and Larry Ellison_, were not available for this profile. That gap is why the confidence is medium.
findings.problem: The thing most likely to overturn this page in five years is old evidence, not a new event. The confidence level is tied to two books from 2003 and 1997 that are obtainable; source notes S32/S33 say only that the Internet Archive copies were lending-restricted, so 'not available' describes this run, not the public record. The record's own research task expects Wilson to document embellishment, yet the body treats that as hypothetical ('if they show a habit of embellishing'), while the Type 8 case leans on the consistency of Ellison's self-report. The thesis claims C47 and C58 are marked durability 'stable' with empty review triggers, so nothing in the record will reopen the typing when the books are read. (I did not open either book; that Wilson catalogues embellished stories is my recollection, unverified here.)
findings.acceptance_test: Either both books are read before release and this passage reports what they show about embellishment and pre-Oracle testimony; or the passage names the missing evidence without implying the books are unobtainable, the body states plainly what a documented embellishment record would do to an argument built on self-report, and C47 and C58 are marked 'unresolved' with a review trigger naming both books and the specific questions to answer.

findings.passage: It is the trash press conference at a different scale: a public doubt about his word, answered with force and no explanation.
findings.problem: This turns the newest and least settled episode into a restatement of the thesis. The trash press conference was a choice between looking better and conceding nothing. A financing guarantee that wins a contested deal is not an approval-versus-control conflict, as the next sentence half admits. Per the draft, the board doubted the family's financing, not 'his word'. 'No explanation' is built from one report that records no comment (S20 context: the words were the company's). What the guarantee means will depend on how the deal, its debt and the pending suit play out. C26 is time_sensitive yet sits in type_hypothesis.for_claim_ids.
findings.acceptance_test: The guarantee is presented as a dated late episode that is consistent with the pattern, with its limits stated (commercial price of the deal, company statement, no words from him), not as an equivalent of the 2000 press conference. 'No explanation' is sourced or cut. Deleting the paragraph leaves the section's argument and the ending intact, and the type case does not count C26 as discriminating evidence.

assessment: Five-year test: the core passes. Remove everything after 2016 and the argument still stands, because it rests on dated self-report (1995, 1997, 2002, 2004, 2016) and three dated choices (1997, 2000, 2010). The hook and ending use the sister story and Jobs's 'Rosebud', not a news peg. Leaving out net worth, wealth rank, later marriages and children removes the facts that age fastest. Most changing facts are dated absolutely and tracked (C26, C32, C33, C34, C59, C80 to C85). The durability risks are narrower. First, the typing itself is the least stable claim and is marked stable: two unread biographies, one expected to document embellishment, could move it toward Type 3, and no trigger reopens it (future-01). Second, the final section puts the most perishable material (age, Skydance, a pending suit, co-CEO names) in the climactic slot and treats the 2025 guarantee as equal to the 2000 press conference (future-02, future-05, future-06). Third, several triggers say 'before publishing', which makes them release conditions no gate enforces, and the body apologises for its own Lanai sourcing (future-04). Fourth, a thesis-bearing 2016 quotation is unconfirmed and unhedged in the FAQ (future-03). Smaller date-precision problems are in future-07 and future-08. Similarity advisory: available and not tripped (max 0.024 against a 0.04 threshold, no shared phrases); the listed pairs are unrelated sentences, and a direct read finds no reused argument beyond the short standard triad description. Limits of this review: sources were not reopened (outside this role), events after mid-2026 are taken from the evidence record as given, and ages are computed from the frontmatter birth date. Risk flags carry forward the record's sensitive_allegations and contested_typing; nothing here adds a new risk category.
